name: Mou 1 Zhong Qingchun
source: Laid-back no-nonsense school text-based game! Inside Yuren Middle School there are many strange clubs, in particular there is the「Cafeteria Rushing Club.」Involving the continued existence of these clubs among other various kinds of adolescent predicaments，totaling 5+1 possible routes！Of course，there is also the high school life of the male protagonist？Here is definitely some kind of adolescent life belonging to you.
